passages.S25.title: S25 · Owambe in Lagos, guest, living in London
passages.S25.context: She is 40, a London resident, flying in for a mixed Igbo and Yoruba wedding in Lagos. The hosts are Lagos-based. She has not bought the aso-ebi and wants to look polished and not out of place.
passages.S25-B: A premium Ankara gown with a structured silhouette, no head covering, statement heels, a clutch.
